claim: MRSC global tables can be created in any combination of three of the 15 supported Regions, including Regions on different continents. The Region list grew recently; older material lists fewer Regions.
question: Which Regions can an MRSC global table use, and what did the recent expansion change?

values.display: any combination of three of these Regions
values.spoken: any three of the supported Regions

qualifiers.condition: the full Region list is on the global tables guide page

evidence.quote: MRSC global tables are available in the following AWS Regions: US East (N. Virginia), US East (Ohio), US West (Oregon), Canada (Central), Europe (Ireland), Europe (London), Europe (Paris), Europe (Frankfurt), Europe (Stockholm), Europe (Spain), Asia Pacific (Tokyo), Asia Pacific (Seoul), Asia Pacific (Osaka), Asia Pacific (Mumbai), and Asia Pacific (Singapore). An MRSC global table can include replicas from any combination of three of these Regions, including Regions on different continents.
You can now create an MRSC global table in any three-Region configuration across the 15 supported AWS Regions, configured with either three replicas or two replicas and one witness Region.

note: Announced 2026-09-23 (What's New), after the 2026-07-15 cutoff: label 'not examinable yet'. The guide page now lists 15 Regions; older material lists fewer Regions and may say MRSC replicas cannot span continents.
